errors.supportMessage: Still not working? Contact us at {email} and we'll help you.

network.title: Oops, something failed
network.message: Don't worry, just check your internet connection and try again.

authentication.title: Your session needs to be renewed
authentication.message: For security reasons, we need you to log in again. It will only take a moment.

authorization.title: Action not available
authorization.message: This action is not enabled for your account. If you think this is an error, contact us.

not_found.title: We couldn't find that
not_found.message: It looks like what you're looking for is no longer available or has been moved.

validation.title: Please review the data
validation.message: Some data needs adjustments. Check the marked fields and try again.

conflict.title: Change in progress
conflict.message: Someone else may be editing this. Refresh the page and try again.

rate_limit.title: Just a moment
rate_limit.message: You're going too fast. Wait a few seconds and try again.

server.title: We're on it
server.message: Something didn't go as expected, but we're already working on it. Try again in a few minutes.

timeout.title: It took longer than expected
timeout.message: The operation took too long. Try again, it usually works the second time.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: Don't worry, these things happen. Try again and if it persists, contact us.

global.title: Oops! Something went wrong
global.message: An unexpected error occurred. Our team has been notified and we're working on fixing it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Error
dashboard.message: An error occurred while loading this section. Try reloading or contact support if the problem persists.

phoneField.tooShort: More digits are needed: this country requires at least {min}.
phoneField.tooLong: Too many digits: this country allows up to {max}.
phoneField.invalid: Check the number: it doesn't look valid for {country}.
